test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 10
subject: general
question: What is the rank of India in terms of ‘area’, among the countries of the world?
solution:
__
 
• **India** is the **seventh largest country__** in the world in terms of land area.
 
• It has a **total area** of about **3.287 million kilometre squares.**
 
• It falls behind Australia with an area of 7.617 million kilometre squares.
